verdicts.reason: Both layouts are essentially the same, and both have the same serious flaws. The SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an unreadable wordmark sitting on the grey circle. The NEW FLAVOR badge is as heavy as the CTA, which competes with it and pulls focus. The can is tiny and its label is illegible. The left side feels crowded, with the body copy squeezed against the right edge. A is worse because of its headline break: 'Chase the' on one line leaves 'Light' alone below it and splits the white/gold colour pairing. B's 'Chase / the Light' keeps the original two-colour phrase together.
